method.decode: FFmpeg select by exact decoded frame index, scale to 160x90, grayscale
method.roi: central 50% width x central 60% height (80x54 pixels after scaling)
method.baseline: for each offset, compare that encoded frame to the immediately preceding encoded frame
method.response: mean absolute per-pixel luma difference between consecutive frames at each offset
method.isolated_rule: no other valid onset within 8 frames before or after

limitations: This is a descriptive image-change association, not proof that audio caused the visual change or that a viewer perceives sync.
The fixed ROI can miss changes outside its bounds; camera/scene movement and overlapping onset responses affect measurements.
Luma deltas do not assess legibility, design quality, motion smoothness, or ±1-frame perceptual alignment.
